page.overview:
Who is Red Hot?

Red Hot is a character from Final Fantasy XIV, introduced in the expansion Dawntrail. He and Deep Blue are known as the Xtremes, a duo of competitors in the Heavyweight tier of the Ascension Arcadia Championship.

Red Hot is a tan-skinned Hyune with silver hair that falls in front of his eyes. He wears yellow swimshorts.

When fused with his feral soul, his skin turns fiery-red and scaly, with flames spouting from his shoulders.

Red Hot is the brawn of the Xtremes to the brains of Deep Blue. He is somewhat dimwitted and prone to talk too much, not realizing he is revealing secrets, unless Deep Blue intervenes.
